fixture.name: installed-rust-tier-boundary
fixture.summary: Bounded two-source Cargo repository whose committed production change moves one equality boundary from exclusive to inclusive while the related test only covers below/above; the expected repair adds one equality test and no production edit.

construction_recipe: git init -b main . && git config core.autocrlf false && git config user.name 'ripr fixture' && git config user.email 'fixture@example.invalid'
write the base snapshot files (repository/base/*) and `git add -A`
GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=2026-10-01T00:00:00Z GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=2026-10-01T00:00:00Z git commit -m 'base: exclusive gold-tier boundary with below/above tests'
write the head snapshot files (repository/head/*) and `git add -A`
GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=2026-10-01T00:01:00Z GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=2026-10-01T00:01:00Z git commit -m 'head: move gold-tier boundary to include exactly 20; ignore cargo build output'
branch variant/no-ignore at the base commit, check out the head src/lib.rs without .gitignore, and commit with the same fixed dates to reproduce the variant commit
repository.recipe_note: Pinned author/committer identity, fixed timestamps and core.autocrlf=false make every commit and tree object reproducible; the recorded commit and tree identities were reproduced from this recipe before being committed.

selected_repair.independent_understanding: head makes tier(20) return gold; the retained test only asserts quantities 19 and 21, so one equality assertion at 20 is the complete bounded repair
